// custom infoparms in the q3map2 format (tests/unit/q3shaders_ref.test.luau, tools/testgen/shader_vectors.c)
// first section: content flags, skipped by DarkPlaces
{
	tvcontent 0x10
	anothercontent 4
}
// second section: surface flags, name then strtol(value, NULL, 0)
{
	tvflag1 0x100000
	TVFlag2 0x40
	tvneg -1
	tvoct 010
	tvbig 99999999999999999999
	tvnegbig -0x80000001
	tvhuge 0x1ffffffff
	tvprec 0x7fffffffffffff01
	tvdup 1
	tvdup 2
	tvx 0x
	tvlast
}
